scope: Retained business evidence plus frozen cold-start and correction-replay attempts. The latest current-format fanout run was dispatched through Workbench, corrected one completed member at the join safe point, preserved the sibling physical task and artifacts, changed only the requested calculator lines, passed all five delivery checks within budget, and received an adopted assessment for the exact delivery revision. This closes the exercised member-replay defect for one local text workflow; it does not establish Corona external-effect recovery, the historical ecommerce replay, or comparable A/B/C performance.

exits.plan_exit: 两个场景都能回答“交了什么、依据什么、要得到什么、怎样算通过”。
exits.finding: The compiler-checked returns-aging sample inherited workflow v1 and its published explicit contract, completed all four authenticated members, produced the required file, and passed coverage, output, artifact content, no-external-effects and output-schema checks. This proves one local text-delivery slice; the original ecommerce and Corona packages retain their documented gaps. A second frozen local text sample also completed a real Workbench correction cycle, passed delivery, and recorded an adopted assessment bound to the exact delivery revision.
exits.remaining: Keep the positive claim limited to this frozen local sample. Historical ecommerce replay identity and Corona incremental recovery remain outside this result.

exits.plan_exit: 历史电商任务是否真实可复验得到明确结论。
exits.finding: The prior exact historical chain remains unavailable, and that limitation is retained. Two new isolated tasks using the frozen open-source benchmark and the repaired published workflow produced decisive results: vendor business state passed 7/7 although its team run failed during verifier response, while invoice completed both members and, after a scoped correction, passed the original verifier 7/7 with no sent mail. This is a new reproducible baseline, not a reconstruction of the old run.
exits.remaining: No further historical reconstruction is claimed. Keep old-run provenance unavailable and use the new frozen runs as the current baseline.

exits.plan_exit: 当前页面没有把阶段完成或文本总结误报为成果核验通过。
exits.finding: Workbench kept execution, five machine delivery checks, and revision-specific user assessment separate. The latest corrected run displayed completed execution and passed delivery before the operator recorded adopted for the exact revision.
exits.remaining: No projection defect remains in this bounded positive/negative pair. Cross-Host user assessment authority remains later scope.

exits.plan_exit: 所有未取得的证据明确记为缺失或 NOT_RUN。
exits.finding: Known missing, partial, unverified and unexecuted checks are explicitly listed without creating fictitious successful samples.
exits.remaining: Maintain these gaps until actual evidence is obtained; documentation completion does not close the other exits.

required_work_not_closed.requirement: 通过内置 Workbench 各发起一个独立样本，派发前确认契约，保存页面证据。
required_work_not_closed.finding: A compiler-checked new sample was dispatched once through Workbench by visible team name, used an authenticated Claude runtime, completed every member, and passed all published-contract checks. The original ecommerce and Corona business packages still contain separate external-effect, historical replay and recovery gaps.

exits.plan_exit: 电商第二次任务无需重新设计流程，且没有跨输入污染。
exits.finding: The earlier invoice dispatch incident remains a retained failure. In the repaired isolated invoice run, the same published workflow v2 was reused without redesign, the input binding matched the new invoice task except for a final newline, both members completed, a scoped follow-up removed only the erroneous star, and the original benchmark verifier passed 7/7 with zero sent mail.
exits.remaining: No further work remains for the bounded repaired ecommerce reuse claim. Do not erase the earlier cross-input failure or generalize from two benchmark tasks to every input class.

exits.plan_exit: 日冕恢复后的重复副作用为零，运行身份和接续关系可审计。
exits.finding: The older bounded receipt sample preserved confirmed operation hashes. In the new current-format local fanout sample, the applied member correction restarted only parallel-01/calculator, preserved parallel-02/reviewer with the same physical task and artifact refs, changed exactly the requested two calculator lines, and rebuilt downstream join/finalizer/delivery successfully. Corona v4 itself did not exercise this recovery and had no bound old artifacts.
exits.remaining: Repeat the now-proven current-format member replay on Corona business materials or an equivalent side-effect-bearing workflow before extending the no-duplicate business claim beyond this local no-external-effects sample.

exits.plan_exit: 两类任务均记录真实用户介入次数、人工处理时间、总耗时和调用消耗。
exits.finding: The repaired invoice evidence records member task timing, tool-call counts, model usage and costs, while the local correction sample records request, ready, confirmation and terminal timestamps, one confirmation, total usage and cost. Corona v4 records wall time, USD cost, input/output tokens and two-runtime participation. A consistently measured active human-handling duration and aligned A/B/C workload are still missing.
exits.remaining: Measure active human handling with a prospective timer and run aligned A/B/C comparators; timestamp gaps alone include model/runtime wait and are not human effort.

exits.plan_exit: 普通可修复错误在契约预算内由系统继续推进，不依赖用户反复输入“继续”。
exits.finding: Durable budget mechanisms remain covered by PostgreSQL tests. The new Workbench run accepted one explicit member correction, waited for the join safe point, presented the bounded impact, resumed after one confirmation, stayed within the fixed USD budget, and required no repeated “continue”. This was an operator-requested adjustment, not an autonomously detected ordinary error.
exits.remaining: Exercise the same bounded continuation on an actual ordinary recoverable fault without a user-authored correction instruction, or keep the autonomous-repair claim open.

recovery_requirements_not_closed.requirement: 预算、剩余工作和未解决问题跨恢复连续。
无法确认副作用时进入待核对。
用户无需重述完整任务或重新建立团队。
recovery_requirements_not_closed.finding: The user could request continuation in natural language, but operators restored the team, supplied the exact team ID and material path, and later prepared a v4 team. Low-burden continuation is not established.

exits.plan_exit: 形成 loom-boundary-decision.md，逐项说明保留、扩大、冻结或退出的能力。
exits.finding: Loom boundary decision v0.4 explicitly retains, admits, freezes and excludes capabilities under current evidence.
exits.remaining: No stage-3 decision work remains. Expansion remains frozen until the listed aligned evidence exists.

exits.plan_exit: 决策引用两个场景的真实证据，不引用模型自评作为采用依据。
exits.finding: The decision cites external evidence from both business scenarios, separates content success from process and delivery gaps, and does not rely on model self-assessment.
exits.remaining: Keep the decision updated if new comparable evidence changes the boundary.

exits.plan_exit: 列出下一阶段唯一主线、明确冻结项和重新考虑冻结项的触发条件。
exits.finding: The decision sets one next product line, freezes Loom expansion, and retains the original 80%, 30% and 15% reconsideration thresholds.
exits.remaining: Reopen expansion only after aligned A/B/C trials satisfy the recorded thresholds without correctness or false-delivery defects.

comparison_thresholds.A: Existing CLI/Runtime path and receipt recovery
comparison_thresholds.B: Minimum contract/receipt/continuation additions on existing path
comparison_thresholds.B_priority_if: At least 80% of C recovery benefit with lower implementation, operations and normal-task cost
comparison_thresholds.C_expand_only_if: Median recovery time at least 30% lower than B; normal task time and token growth each at most 15%; no new correctness, duplicate-effect or false-delivery defect
comparison_thresholds.note: The original plan thresholds are retained; no percentages are calculated from unlike tasks or missing comparator data.
